For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Bhaskar Shankar
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Bharat Lal
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
 Oral Order
4 20-06-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner has prayed for bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 302,
376, 120(B), 363, 366(A), 34 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 4/6 of POCSO Act.
Prosecution case relates to abduction of 15 years old minor daughter of the informant by co-accused Yogendra Bharti and thereafter committed murder of the victim girl.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He is not named in the FIR.

His name transpired in this case on the basis of confessional statement of main accused Yogendra Bharti, before the police which has got no evidentiary Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64734 of 2022(4) dt.20-06-2023 value in the eye of law.
During investigation, no consistent material has come against the petitioner to show his involvement in the present case.

Similarly situated other accused person has already been enlarged on bail by another coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 16.5.2023 passed in Cr. Misc. No.
65274 of 2022.
Petitioner has got no criminal antecedent and languishing in judicial custody since 27.6.2022.
Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.
